basic_info.description: Calling all house hackers, flippers, and visionaries! Incredible opportunity in San Francisco's SOMA neighborhood. Built in 1924, this two-unit building offers 3BDs and 2BAs, ready for you to make your mark. Hardwood floors, tall ceilings, picture rails, tons of light, and great floor plans. The full-footprint garage is massive, fitting up to 6 cars, and opens the possibilities for expansion, creative projects, or anything from engineering workshops to mechanic spaces. The property boasts a fully fenced, flat yard with mature landscaping. The top-floor unit is tenant-occupied with market rents, while the lower unit will be delivered vacant, giving you flexibility right away. And for city lovers, you're close to everything: nightlife, street fairs, top restaurants, and highways, with Downtown, Mission Bay, and Market Street just minutes away. 10.7% projected cap rate after development, $1.3M estimated ARV.
